title: Local Way: Local Experiences
description:
Discover authentic experiences and explore every destination with the people who truly know it.

Local Way is the app for finding and booking local experiences, activities, and things to do in the villages and destinations you visit.

Discover tastings, food experiences, outdoor activities, traditions, craftsmanship, culture, guided visits, excursions, and places beyond the usual tourist routes.

With Local Way, you do more than simply visit a place: you experience it through the people who live there.

Live like a local

Looking for things to do during your trip, places to discover nearby, or an experience that feels different from the usual?

Open Local Way and discover activities available near you, or search for experiences in the destination you want to visit.

Explore experiences by location, category, and interests, check all the available details, and choose the one that best fits your trip.

Experiences created by people who live there

The experiences on Local Way are offered by Local Advisors: local people, professionals, producers, artisans, and businesses who truly know their area.

You can discover experiences such as:
• wine, olive oil, and local food tastings
• lunches and local food experiences
• activities on farms and in vineyards
• artisan and traditional workshops
• excursions and outdoor activities
• cultural experiences and village visits
• sea and fishing-related activities
• experiences with local producers and communities
• itineraries to discover lesser-known places

Every place has a story to tell. Local Way helps you find the people who can help you experience it.

Discover what to do around you

If you are already travelling, use Local Way to find experiences and activities nearby.

Explore what is around you, discover new villages, and find activities that often do not appear in traditional tourist itineraries.

You can also search for a destination before you leave and plan the experiences you want to enjoy in advance.

Find the right experience for you

With Local Way, you can:
• search for local experiences and activities
• explore experiences by destination
• filter activities based on your interests
• discover things to do nearby
• view photos and information about each experience
• learn more about the people organizing the activity
• choose a date and number of participants
• send a request or book when available
• save the experiences you love to your favourites
• manage your bookings directly from the app

Everything in one place.

Go beyond the usual routes

Local Way was created to make it easier to discover authentic experiences in small villages and local destinations.

From historic centres to nature, from the countryside to the coast, you can find activities connected to food, culture, craftsmanship, and local traditions.

Don’t just ask yourself what to see.
Ask yourself what you can experience.

Travel through people

Behind every place there are people, stories, and traditions.

That is why Local Way puts the relationship between travellers and local communities at the centre, helping you connect with the people who truly know the area.

Discover a workshop.
Meet a producer.
Take part in a tradition.
Taste a local product.
Explore a place you had never planned to visit.

Turn a simple visit into an experience worth remembering.

Experience what others miss.
From Stranger to Local.

Discover more at www.local-way.com

title: Get Local Experiences
description:
Get Local is your guide to the best of Jamaica. From beach escapes and food spots to festivals, nightlife and cultural day trips, Get Local helps you find what's happening, book it, and enjoy it, all in one app.

Built for travellers and locals alike, Get Local makes it easy to see what's on today, tonight or this weekend, connect with trusted hosts, and book with confidence from start to finish.

Explore 200+ experiences across every parish, from Kingston to Negril. Check live availability, book instantly, and get your confirmation in seconds. Message hosts directly to ask questions or tailor your plans. Check out quickly and securely with DimePay, then rate your experiences to help others find the good stuff.

Filter by category, date, price or parish to find exactly what you're in the mood for. Save favourites for later, get instant booking updates and notifications, and keep browsing even when your signal drops. Manage your bookings and keep track of upcoming trips in one place.

Get Local puts the real Jamaica in your pocket, so every trip, weekend or night out is one to remember.

title: Local & Traveler
description:
A new city is so much more than its iconic landmarks.

Local & Traveler connects travelers with locals who can help them experience the city they are visiting from a different perspective.

Discover locals based on your destination, travel dates, interests, and preferences. Explore their profiles, find the person who best fits your trip, and send your offer directly through the app.

With Local & Traveler:

• Meet Locals — Connect with people who actually live in the city you are visiting.

• Discover a Different Side of the City — Go beyond the usual tourist routes and experience the city through a local's eyes.

• Find the Right Local for You — Explore profiles, interests, languages, and experiences to find someone who fits your travel style.

• Plan Your Experience — Choose your destination and travel date, select the right local for you, and create an offer based on your plans.

• Travel More Socially — Turn a new city into a more personal, social, and unforgettable experience.

If you know your city inside out, you can become a Local on Local & Traveler, meet travelers, and earn money by sharing the city you know best.

Live like a local.

title: Localie: Local Travel Guide
description:
Discover cities through the people who know them best.

Localie is a local travel guide for discovering hidden gems, things to do, restaurants, bars, neighborhoods and authentic local experiences — recommended by real people who live there.

Whether you're planning a trip, looking for a city guide, searching for things to do nearby or want to explore with a local guide, Localie helps you experience a destination beyond the usual tourist attractions.

DISCOVER PLACES LOCALS ACTUALLY LOVE

Find local recommendations for restaurants, cafés, bars, viewpoints, neighborhoods, cultural spots and hidden gems.

Instead of generic travel lists, discover places recommended by locals who know the city and can explain why they're worth visiting.

EXPLORE THE CITY ON A MAP

Open the Localie map to see recommendations around you.

Discover restaurants, attractions, local favorites and things to do nearby, understand what's worth exploring in each neighborhood and easily decide where to go next.

MEET YOUR AI TRAVEL CONCIERGE

Not sure what to do?

Ask your AI concierge for ideas based on your interests, location and plans.

Get help finding places, discovering things to do, planning your day and navigating local recommendations — while still benefiting from the knowledge shared by real locals.

MEET LOCAL GUIDES

Every recommendation comes from a real person.

Explore local profiles, learn about their interests and experience, and find locals who can help you discover the city in a way that matches how you like to travel.

BOOK A LOCAL EXPERIENCE

Want more than recommendations?

Book a trusted local and explore the city together.

From walking through hidden neighborhoods to food, culture, nightlife, architecture or a completely personalized day, Localie offers a more personal alternative to traditional tours.

FIND THINGS TO DO

Use Localie when searching for:

• Things to do nearby
• Hidden gems
• Local restaurants and bars
• Sightseeing
• Walking tours
• Local guides
• City tours
• Local experiences
• Attractions
• Neighborhoods to explore
• Trip planning ideas
• Authentic travel experiences

TRAVEL LIKE YOU KNOW SOMEONE THERE

Localie brings together local recommendations, an interactive city map, an AI travel concierge and real local guides in one app.

Explore Istanbul, Amsterdam, Paris, London, Barcelona, Lisbon, Rome, Berlin, Prague, Vienna, Copenhagen, Athens and more destinations around the world.

Skip generic tourist lists. Discover the places locals actually go, understand the stories behind them and meet the people who make each city unique.

Because the best way to discover a place is through someone who calls it home.

Localie — the world where your people are everywhere.

title: City Experiences
description:
At Hornblower Cruises & Events, our promise to you is memories that last a lifetime and feelings that bring a smile to your face for years to come. We cherish every new person who joins us on one of our yachts, and are thrilled to welcome back customers who return year after year. Come onboard with us and enjoy the wind in your hair, the salty, fresh smell of the ocean all around you, and stunning coastal views.  

Our mobile application allows you to easily search our events across the country, purchase a ticket, download your tickets to get scanned at the yachts, and get live chat support for common questions about our amazing experiences.   

BOOK EXPERIENCES
Go on local experiences in one of our multitude of cities, whether it's for multiple days or just a morning brunch. Explore the Statue of Liberty, Niagara Falls, Alcatraz, or any of our incredible cruises.  

DOWNLOAD YOUR TICKETS 
Simply enter the confirmation number into our app in order to store your tickets.  When entering your confirmation number we send you push notifications as it gets closer to event time with helpful tips. 

SUPPORT
Via the app you can get support for your cruise purchase, whether just a simple question or a complex question for the big cruise day.

title: Local Secrets Travel
description:
ocal Secrets is an exceptional travel planning app that allows users to organize their itinerary in advance, recommending the most iconic places, notable events, and suggested routes at their destination. Currently, the app is operational in over 100 locations, with plans to expand to over 200 within the next year.

OUR PRINCIPLES
Exploring the world and its cultural diversity is only possible with the right mindset and with the support of initiatives like Local Secrets, which bring travelers closer to the essence of local communities. Principles are fundamental to defining and structuring a project, especially when it is a global initiative based on local culture and customs. We will only recommend businesses, services, and experiences that have been previously reviewed and endorsed by other users, and that demonstrate a history of continuous improvement and excellent customer service.

MAIN OBJECTIVES OF LOCAL SECRETS
To promote cultural and local immersion by discovering secrets that are generally unknown to tourists. To become a global platform where all necessary travel-related products and services can be acquired.

PURPOSE
To present the best places and events of each destination in a clear and attractive way, ensuring quality and access to an authentic local immersion for the traveler.

VISION
To become the reference tool for planning any type of trip, whether it is a group, family, or business trip.

title: Local-eSIM: Travel Data eSIMs
description:
✈️ Travel the World without Roaming Charges with a 🌍 Local-eSIM
Simply choose the country or region you are visiting and select the local data eSIM that’s best for your trip, there are hundreds to choose from.

Once you have purchased your local-eSIM, it can be stored in your app to activate on arrival. If you have multiple local-eSIMs, you can queue them to be used in the order required.

💼 How it works
1. Install the Local-eSIM app
2. Select your travel destination & purchase a data bundle
3. Install the eSIM on your device
4. Switch on your eSIM's data roaming upon arrival

💡 You can track your usage and get alerts by SMS or email when data is running low. Should you need more data, you can easily top-up your eSIM in the app, and queue data bundles to use once your current bundle runs out for uninterrupted connectivity.

🌟 Product Highlights
- Data coverage in 190+ countries
- Affordable local rates – pay only for what you need
- Queue multiple eSIMs for multi-country travel
- Top up or add additional eSIMs easily inside the app
- Real-time usage tracking & smart alerts
- No contracts, no roaming fees, no throttling

📘 What is a Local-eSIM?
eSIMs are virtual sims that can be embedded in your device to be used instead of a physical SIM.  A local eSIM means you will only pay local data rates worldwide. Each local-eSIM will have a fixed amount of data and a fixed amount of days, weeks or months to use it in.

🌐 Available in over 190 Countries!
Local-eSIMs are available in over 190 countries and we have regional travel data bundles to suit any traveller's connectivity needs, including:

🇺🇸 United States
🇬🇧 United Kingdom
🇫🇷 France
🇮🇹 Italy
🇹🇷 Turkey
🇪🇸 Spain
🇮🇳 India
🇩🇪 Germany
🇨🇦 Canada
… and many more! 🌍✨

Why chose local-eSIM?
We pride ourselves on giving clear choices, we will not use tricks to slow down data speeds or offer unlimited bundles with a restricted fair use policy or daily limit.

We offer local-eSIMs from only the best local partners to give you a seamless service.

Who is a Travel eSIM from Local-eSIM for?
🌍 Frequent travellers, digital nomads & remote workers
🚢 Crew Members such as seafarers, cruise crews and flight attendants needing round the World connectivity
🎒 Backpackers, students, and international residents on the move
📶 Anyone that wants easy and affordable access to travel data — no roaming fees or SIM swaps required

For more information about Local-eSIM and our eSIMs visit:
Local-eSIM Website: www.local-esim.com
Help Centre: www.help.local-esim.com
